description.value: Megabite is a Vancouver-based pizza franchise with several Lower Mainland locations, including this one on Granville Street in the heart of the city's entertainment district. The menu spans pizza, wings, poutine, and sides, with online ordering, delivery, and a catering service. Vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free options are available, making it a practical food stop for groups with mixed dietary needs.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 13m; stands (4 spaces) at 25m; stands (2 spaces) at 26m; stands (2 spaces) at 67m; stands (4 spaces, covered) at 72m; stands (8 spaces) at 80m; stands (2 spaces) at 89m. Total: 24 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and consistent with a multi-location pizza franchise; the /contact-us page lists 'Granville & Nelson' as a named location, corroborating the OSM address of 1005 Granville Street. OSM tags diet:vegan=yes, diet:vegetarian=yes, and diet:gluten_free=yes are supported by the website catering page which explicitly references 'Vegetarian and meat pizzas'. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, or Wi-Fi information appears in either the OSM tags or website content, so those fields are null.
concerns: OSM name is 'Megabite' but the business brands itself as 'Megabite Pizza' on all website pages
